blocks.html: With the Bicol region recently devastated by super typhoon Rolly, RLC R Love, together with the Gokongwei Brothers Foundation and Robinsons Bank joined forces extending a helping hand to affected barangays in Naga. Leading the relief operations in 12 barangays were the brave and gallant employees of Robinsons Place Naga. Over two thousand families received relief packs containing medical and hygiene kits, food and water. Also present to during the relief operation were Mayor Nelson Legacion and CSWDO head Ms. Anabel Vargas.
